Screen-space ambient occlusion. Also toggles shadow smoothing.

Metres added around the subject's bounds. Covers fast attachments and hair.

Cap for the automatic reach, in metres.

Blend width at the column edge, as a fraction of the column.
Snaps the column to a world texel grid so it does not shimmer.
How many projector lights cast shadows at once. Each adds a shadow pass per frame.
